scope: Focused literature collection, not an exhaustive systematic review or a repair experiment. Public metadata excludes patient identifiers, medical files and local absolute paths.
queries: Self-supervised medical slice interpolation controllable feature flow
Medical image interpolation based on multi-resolution registration

records.title: Registration-based interpolation
records.reading_scope: PubMed abstract and author institution record
records.claim: B-spline nonrigid registration followed by intensity interpolation along correspondences; abstract reports 20 tomographic datasets.
records.limitations: Cohort details and coronary validation not verified.

records.title: A new method for registration-based medical image interpolation
records.claim: Modified control-grid registration and cubic interpolation of corresponding intensities.
records.limitations: No executable implementation or target-domain validation verified.

records.title: Medical image interpolation based on multi-resolution registration
records.reading_scope: Publisher abstract; description and reference in R05
records.claim: Multiresolution B-spline registration followed by linear or cubic intensity interpolation.
records.limitations: Direct publisher open failed; full text not obtained. No code availability conclusion.

records.title: An Optimization Method For Slice Interpolation Of Medical Images
records.claim: Curvature-constrained registration estimates intermediate slices between known images.
records.limitations: Limited illustrative evaluation; no coronary CT validation established.

records.title: Convolutional Neural Networks vs. Deformable Image Registration For Medical Slice Interpolation
records.reading_scope: HTML introduction, methods and evaluation; PDF pages 3-4
records.claim: Comparison uses withheld even slices in chest CT and brain MRI, evaluating error, similarity and sharpness.
records.limitations: Small experimental datasets; sharpness is not the same as faithful anatomy.

records.title: SAINT: Spatially Aware Interpolation NeTwork for Medical Slice Synthesis
records.reading_scope: Paper abstract and first-page introduction; author README and repository tree
records.claim: Spatially aware medical slice synthesis evaluated on abdominal CT; author checkpoint documentation supports x4 and x6.
records.limitations: Checkpoint availability is not execution verification; no confirmed x2/x3 checkpoint in inspected tree.

records.title: Slice imputation: Multiple intermediate slices interpolation for anisotropic 3D medical image segmentation
records.reading_scope: Abstract, method overview, section 4.1 datasets and evaluation, PDF page 5
records.claim: Synthesizes intermediate slices and labels, with evaluation including CT liver tumor and brain/prostate MRI segmentation.
records.limitations: No author code confirmed in this search. Downstream segmentation benefits do not establish coronary missing-slice fidelity.

records.title: Self-supervised medical slice interpolation network using controllable feature flow
records.reading_scope: Indexed publisher abstract; author README, full repository tree and test entry source
records.claim: CFFNet uses position-conditioned feature flow; published abstract includes hepatic-vessel evaluation.
records.limitations: Full paper not obtained. Test branch N_ot=2 uses 0.25,0.75, not equal-gap 1/3,2/3; imported utils/options directories not found in inspected tree.

records.title: I3Net: Inter-Intra-slice Interpolation Network for Medical Slice Synthesis
records.reading_scope: HTML method overview, section IV-A datasets/implementation, selected discussion; author repository tree
records.claim: Inter/intra-slice and cross-view synthesis; abdominal CT and brain MRI; inspected Colon_x2/x4/x6 checkpoint files.
records.limitations: No coronary validation or x3 checkpoint confirmed. Registry license field is null; this is not an inferred redistribution license.

records.title: An Anisotropic Cross-View Texture Transfer with Multi-Reference Non-Local Attention for CT Slice Interpolation
records.reading_scope: HTML method overview and dataset sections; repository README/tree; author institution publication record
records.claim: ACVTT uses in-plane references for through-plane synthesis; includes RPLHR-CT real pairs and synthetically downsampled data.
records.limitations: README supports x2,x3,x4,x5; no common-extension weight files found in inspected full tree. This does not rule out other distribution channels.

records.title: SAGCNet: Spatial-Aware Graph Completion Network for Missing Slice Imputation in Population CMR Imaging
records.reading_scope: PDF abstract and page 6 datasets; author README and tree
records.claim: Missing-slice synthesis in cardiac MRI using volumetric graph/context information.
records.limitations: Related modality, not CT; inspected author repository contains only README and says code will be uploaded soon.

records.title: CardioInterp: Generative Modeling for Cardiovascular OCT Interpolation with Anatomical Continuity and Fidelity
records.reading_scope: Abstract, introduction and method overview in online PDF
records.claim: Intermediate B-slice synthesis for cardiovascular OCT.
records.limitations: OCT is not coronary CT. Author code link noted but repository not independently inspected.

records.title: VascuSR: Iterative Anatomy-Aware Diffusion for CT Super-Resolution
records.claim: In-plane CT super-resolution with 3D vascular guidance; appendix includes coronary examples.
records.limitations: Not through-plane missing-slice interpolation; recent preprint, not independently reproduced.

repository_checks.availability_note: Weights listed, not loaded; test entry has missing local import directories and N_ot=2 quarter-position branch.
Only README exists in the inspected full repository tree; implementation pending.

source_notes: Published year, online year and preprint date are distinguished where verified.
Abstract-only evidence is not treated as full-paper review.
Downloaded PDF hashes identify reading copies; PDF files remain local-only.
Author code and weight metadata were inspected, but no training or inference ran.
